definition: 179 exact municipality-level public-source fields from the NJ DCA User Friendly Budget Database 2025 Summary. No derived score or qualitative inference is included.
activation_rule: Markers enter planned. Live state requires a committed source artifact, authenticated production canary, provider coverage, and static governance reconciliation.

source_contract.warning: Official NJ DCA compilation of municipal User Friendly Budget submissions. DCA states all data are self-reported by municipalities and have not been independently audited or verified; missing submissions and blank/obvious-error cells may have no data.

markers.label: RUT tax collection percentage
markers.description: NJ DCA User Friendly Budget 2025 Summary source field: Tax Collections and Delinquent Taxes — % of Tax Collections used to Calculate RUT. DCA glossary: The percentage of tax collections used to calculate the reserve for uncollected taxes in the current budget year.  The reserve for uncollected taxes is designed to ensure sufficient cash receipts to support municipal operations and property taxes due to school, county, local, and special districts.

markers.label: Structural imbalance: revenues at risk
markers.description: NJ DCA User Friendly Budget 2025 Summary source field: Structural Imbalances — Revenues at Risk. DCA glossary: Anticipated revenues that will not recur in the next budget year, or that are known to be declining over time (i.e.  revenues from one time land sales; concession fees or deposits associated with agreements, including redevelopment agreements or utility agreements; short term or expiring grants that support operating costs; transfers of funds from authorities that are not expected to continue; awards of Transitional Aid from the State; and other revenues that are known to be temporary in nature).
markers.source_field: Structural Imbalances · Revenues at Risk

markers.label: Structural imbalance: non-recurring appropriation reductions
markers.description: NJ DCA User Friendly Budget 2025 Summary source field: Structural Imbalances — Non-recurring Appropriation Reductions. DCA glossary: Proposed reductions in line items that will not recur in the next budget year, or that are known to be declining over time (i.e. non-recurring cost reductions, short term savings in debt service payments attributable to refunding issues that allow for a skipped debt service payment or reductions in short term maturities; and savings in expenses made possible through contractual short term concessions that result in later increased payments)
markers.source_field: Structural Imbalances · Non-recurring Appropriation Reductions

markers.label: Structural imbalance: future-year appropriation increases
markers.description: NJ DCA User Friendly Budget 2025 Summary source field: Structural Imbalances — Future Year Appropriation Increases. DCA glossary: Reasonable projections of appropriation increases for the next budget year (i.e. : increases in debt service payments due to new or restructured debt; increases in lease payments due to new or restructured leases; increased salary or compensation payments attributable to contractual obligations; and other increases in items of expenditure for which policy changes or decisions will necessitate increased appropriations)
markers.source_field: Structural Imbalances · Future Year Appropriation Increases

markers.label: Structural imbalance offsets
markers.description: NJ DCA User Friendly Budget 2025 Summary source field: Structural Imbalances — Structural Imbalance Offsets. DCA glossary: Budget changes that are expected to occur in the next budget year that offset the impact of the three above-referenced categories (i.e. new or one-time current year appropriations or non-recurring increases in current year appropriations that will not appear in the next budget year and out-year budgets)
markers.source_field: Structural Imbalances · Structural Imbalance Offsets
